description: NaGaBP₂H₃O₁₀ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (2.32 Å) and two longer (2.69 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Ga is bonded in a distorted square co-planar geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (1.88 Å) and two longer (2.01 Å) Ga-O bond lengths. B is bonded in a linear geometry to two equivalent O atoms. Both B-O bond lengths are 1.25 Å. P is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.52-1.63 Å. There are two inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a linear geometry to two equivalent O atoms. Both H-O bond lengths are 1.19 Å. In the second H site, H is bonded in a linear geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.14 Å) and one longer (1.25 Å) H-O bond length. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Ga, one P, and one H atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one B and one H atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, one P, and one H atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Ga and one P atom.
